title: Newsletter → Social Media Workflow
text:
One JSON file per month drives everything: the post graphics, the captions tracker (social-media-captions.xlsx), and the Linktree (index.qmd).
posts/2026-11.json  ──make_post.py──▶  images/Nov 2026/*-final.png  (+ posts/2026-11_preview.png)
                    ──publish_month.py──▶  social-media-captions.xlsx rows + index.qmd buttons



Pick items. Read the newsletter; skip anything already in the tracker (match on title / link). Aim for one post per newsletter item.
Collect sources. Save each item’s photo into images/<Mon YYYY>/source/. Resolve tracking links (list-manage.com) to the real destination URL.
Write the spec. Copy posts/2026-11.json to posts/<YYYY-MM>.json and fill in one entry per post (image fields + caption + optional linktree).
Render. python tools/make_post.py posts/<YYYY-MM>.json --preview — check the contact sheet, tweak focus / zoom / headline_pos / wash, re-run with --only <id>.
Publish to tracker + Linktree. python tools/publish_month.py posts/<YYYY-MM>.json (safe to re-run: tracker rows are matched on the image file name and refreshed; Linktree links already present are skipped). Then quarto render index.qmd and push.
Pick caption options in the tracker, post, mark Posted = Yes.











Element
Rule




Size
1080 × 1350 (IG 4:5 grid)


Banner
UCLA Blue #2774AE, 135 px, white bold ALL-CAPS eyebrow (“NEW REPORT!”, “SAVE THE DATE!”, “WELCOME TO THE TEAM!”)


Headline
White bold on per-line blue boxes, bottom-left. For wide group photos use "headline_pos": "band": full-width photo with the headline centered on a blue band below, so no faces are covered


Wash
true for buildings, scenery, archival photos; false for people-focused photos


Layouts
photo (default) · document (report/brief/journal cover shown whole; omit headline since the cover has the title) · text (no usable photo; headline + detail lines)







Two options (A = warm/celebratory, B = hook-question or punchier), same hashtag set appended to each.
End with “Link in bio” only when there’s a content_source (and a Linktree entry).
Always include ALT TEXT. NOTE flags: photo credits, identifiable minors / media releases, policy-sensitive framing, unconfirmed titles, [confirm @handle] for partner tags.
Stick to the newsletter’s wording for facts; don’t add claims.




See the docstrings at the top of tools/make_post.py (image fields) and tools/publish_month.py (caption / linktree fields). linktree.section is one of events, news, projects, reports.
